symptom: ako/mxcli#2133 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1814): `set (NoEntityMessage: '…') on dv` was refused ('not a property of this built-in widget'), and describe left a data view's 'no entity' message out, so a describe round trip dropped it.
cause: Forms$DataView.NoEntityMessage (a Texts$Text) was modelled and written (widget_write.go) but nothing filled it: the builder never read the property, describe never printed it, and the ALTER setter had no case for it.
insight: A writer that serialises a model field nothing populates is a round-trip loss waiting to be found: grep the model struct's fields against the builder and the describe reader. Verified on TestApp: create, alter set, describe -> exec Unchanged, mx check 0 errors.
